intro: One stall-style burger ayam with egg is an estimated 500 kcal. Most of the calories come from the patty, fried egg, margarine and mayo.
diet: Yes, a late-night burger won't automatically ruin your diet. 500 kcal still fits as one dinner. The usual problem is adding a sweet drink and eating two. One burger with plain water, and you're still on track.
tips: Ask for 'mayo sikit' and less margarine.
Want more protein? Double egg is a better pick than double patty.
Ask for extra salad and cucumber, and have it with plain water or teh o kosong.

swap.name: Burger ayam biasa, no egg, less mayo
swap.why: You still get that stall burger taste. Less oil and sauce, saving about 140 kcal.

faq.q: Telur bungkus or fried egg, which one is nicer?
faq.a: Telur bungkus is more popular at stalls because the patty is wrapped in egg. Nutrition-wise, they're about the same.
Most stalls use patties with a halal logo. If you're unsure, check the patty packaging or ask the seller.

faq.q: Can I keep the burger and eat it tomorrow?
faq.a: Yes, keep it in the fridge and reheat it. But the bun will go soggy, so it's nicer eaten right away.
